integrity: The proof combines the exact substitution identity for subsequence ideals with complete left-quotient enumeration. The package contains a 150-state, 300-transition certificate across the two inputs and output, and an independently constructed substitution-NFA cross-check. Public files contain mathematical material and reproducibility details only.
scientific_limitations: A single finite binary witness refutes the exact multiplicative quotient-complexity bound; it gives neither an optimal minimum counterexample nor an asymptotic superquadratic lower bound. The full subsequent author-hosted version was not available for complete comparison. External independent audit is not performed.
title: A binary counterexample to the singular-substitution state-complexity product bound
